name_zh: 麻布屋 Azabuya（乌鲁木齐中路店）
description_en: Japanese matcha gelato brand (小红书: Azabuya麻布屋 / 麻布屋风物手帖 / 今天麻布了没), run by Shanghai Yongban Catering Management Co. Ltd Minhang Branch (上海永坂餐饮管理有限公司闵行分公司). This location is on Wulumuqi Middle Road, a 520m walk from Exit 7 of Changshu Road station on metro Line 7. Hours 10:00-22:00. Menu: double scoop 35rmb, triple scoop 38rmb, cone 40rmb, 450ml tub 90rmb, 1kg box 120rmb, 1.5kg box 180rmb. Four flavors carry a premium: Matcha #2 and pistachio (tub 95rmb, 1kg box 150rmb, 1.5kg box 225rmb), Matcha #3 (tub 98rmb, 1kg box 210rmb, 1.5kg box 315rmb), Matcha #5 (tub 115rmb, 1kg box 380rmb, 1.5kg box 480rmb). Of the three matcha concentration levels (#2/#3/#5), #3 is the recommended middle ground — #5 tends to taste bitter. Other flavors: black sesame, hojicha, lychee white tea, Japanese yuzu, pistachio, raspberry, grapefruit sea-salt lychee, shochu chocolate, Greek yogurt. The brand has 5 locations in Shanghai (Wulumuqi Middle Road, Xingye Taikoo Hui, Shanghai IFC Mixc Minhang, Yongkang Road, Yanping Road) plus branches in Hangzhou, Shenzhen, and Suzhou.
description_zh: 日式抹茶冰淇淋品牌（小红书号：Azabuya麻布屋、麻布屋风物手帖、今天麻布了没），由上海永坂餐饮管理有限公司闵行分公司运营。本店位于乌鲁木齐中路，距地铁7号线常熟路站7号口步行520米，营业时间10:00-22:00。价格：双拼35rmb，三拼38rmb，蛋筒40rmb，桶装450ml90rmb，盒装1kg120rmb，盒装1.5kg180rmb；四个口味有特殊定价：抹茶#2和开心果（桶装95rmb，盒装1kg150rmb，盒装1.5kg225rmb），抹茶#3（桶装98rmb，盒装1kg210rmb，盒装1.5kg315rmb），抹茶#5（桶装115rmb，盒装1kg380rmb，盒装1.5kg480rmb）。抹茶#2、#3、#5三种浓度里，建议选#3，#5会比较苦。其他口味：黑芝麻、焙茶、荔枝白茶、日本柚子、开心果、树莓、西柚海盐荔枝、烧酒巧克力、希腊酸奶。该品牌在上海共有5家门店（乌鲁木齐中路店、兴业太古汇店、上海万象城店、永康路店、延平路店），另外在杭州、深圳、苏州也有门店。
